name: @r4/shadow
description: R4-H Shadow / E2E framework: WorkloadCase, explicit shadow execution mode, domain binding classification (ShadowExecutionPolicy), side-effect recording and manifest, shadow outbound sink, ShadowRun / ShadowSuiteRun composed over the R4-G benchmark, cost guard, operational aggregates, sanitization, ArchitectureGapCandidate and artifacts.
